Frequently Asked Questions

What is Mars Men boost?

Mars Men’s Boost Natural Testosterone Support* is Mars Men's complete natural testosterone support system.  
Research shows average testosterone levels  in American men have fallen across generations, independent of normal age-related decline. Levels also decline as men age, and low testosterone grows more common past 40. 1234

Who is Mars Men Boost for?

Mars Men is for men over the age of 18 looking to support their testosterone in a safe, natural, and research-backed way.

How do I take Mars Men BOOST?

Best results are achieved by taking 5 capsules daily in the AM with food.

HOW LONG UNTIL I SEE RESULTS?

Results vary from person to person, but here's what many men report:   

Week 1: You wake up before the alarm instead of fighting it. The 3pm crash starts to become a thing of the past. 

Weeks 2-4: The gym stops feeling like punishment. Men report noticing strength coming back. A little more drive, a little more fire.   

Week 8 and beyond: This is where men tell us it clicks. The ingredients have had time to work with your system, and the fuller range of benefits tends to show up: energy, strength, and that edge you'd started to think was gone for good.

Can Mars Men Boost help increase my energy?

Mars Men supports healthy male hormones, such as testosterone, which are critical for living a vital, energized life.

Will Mars Men Boost improve my strength gains in the gym?

Mars Men is formulated to support your body's natural testosterone production, and healthy testosterone levels play a key role in strength, recovery, and building lean muscle. Many men tell us they feel stronger and more capable in the gym after consistent use. Combined with regular training, it's built to support the work you're already putting in. Individual results vary.

Will Boost help me lose weight?

There's a reason your gut won't budge on the same diet that used to work. Body fat runs aromatase, the enzyme that converts testosterone into estrogen… and estrogen stores more belly fat.
The fat feeds the loop that built it.  

Boost helps support the hormonal environment that makes getting lean feel less like an uphill battle. Healthy testosterone supports lean muscle, energy, training performance, and a more favorable body composition, while healthier cortisol helps your body stop acting like every calorie needs to be stored for an emergency.  

Using a GLP-1? Boost makes even more sense. Losing weight is only half the battle. You want to keep your muscle, strength, drive, and masculine edge while the scale drops. Boost helps support the foundation behind all four, so you come out leaner, stronger, and feeling like yourself.

How does Boost help with cortisol?

Testosterone and cortisol compete for the same raw materials, and when your body thinks it’s under attack, cortisol wins every time.  


That’s why you can sleep eight hours, eat clean, train consistently, and still wake up feeling flat, foggy, soft, and unmotivated. Your body may be stuck in survival mode instead of build mode.  


Boost helps restore a healthier testosterone-to-cortisol balance, so stress stops running the show. The result? Steadier energy, clearer focus, a more defined jaw and waistline, and the drive to attack your day instead of surviving it.

Can Boost help in the bedroom?

That’s one of the first places many men notice their edge slipping, and one of the biggest reasons they start taking Boost. Healthy testosterone supports desire, performance, confidence, energy, and the instinct to initiate instead of making excuses. Boost gives your body daily support to produce, free, protect, and use its own testosterone more effectively. No timing the little blue pill. Just consistent support for your desire, confidence, and masculine drive that’s ready when you are.

Do I need to cycle Mars Men?

Nope. Mars Men is built for daily, ongoing use . No cycling on and off required. In fact, consistency is where the results live. The ingredients build in your system over weeks, so the men who see the most are the ones who take it every day and don't interrupt the momentum.

Do I have to sign up for a subscription?

If you go with a subscription, it renews on its own, but you're in control. Cancel, pause, or reschedule anytime.


Mars Men Boost works best taken daily, without interruption. Consistency is what lets the ingredients support your body over time. A subscription just makes that automatic, so you don't lose momentum.  


We want you to feel good about what you're taking. That's why you can try Mars Men risk-free for 90 days.  


Grab a single bottle to try it out, or subscribe and save if you want it handled automatically.
